channel.title: Federal News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Federal News Network (federalnewsnetwork.com)

item.title: ‘Radical reduction’ of GSA-owned buildings needed to address growing maintenance backlog, panel finds
item.description: The report finds that some GSA-owned federal buildings are in such poor condition that the cost to demolish or repair them “outweighs any potential reuse.”

item.title: Trump fires Homeland Security Secretary Noem after mounting criticism over her leadership
item.description: Oklahoma Republican Sen. Markwayne Mullin says he has no idea how quickly his nomination to replace Noem at the Department of Homeland Security will move.

item.title: Understanding how FEHB and Medicare work together in retirement
item.description: With updates to the FEHB program and new requirements for certain retirees, it’s more important than ever to understand how FEHB and Medicare work together.

item.title: AI systems are only as safe as the environments where they’re trained and tested
item.description: "You have to go through emulation, attacking, and really testing every single controls that you're putting into place," said Bri Frost.

item.title: When Congress gets hacked: Why cyber oversight can’t wait
item.description: There is an urgent need for stronger congressional leadership in cyber policy, especially when it comes to countering China’s persistent, aggressive intrusions.

item.title: GSA to be designated as QSMO for acquisition
item.description: The new "QSMO" comes as the Trump administration seeks to consolidate roughly 230 acquisition systems across the federal government.

item.title: A massive reinvestment push is reshaping military housing
item.description: "In many cases our youngest families that are moving into military housing, they've never lived in a home that is now theirs," said Brian Stann.

item.title: Key data on political appointees missing from ‘PLUM’ book
item.description: The latest version of the PLUM book lacks data for seven federal entities and 130 politically appointed positions, the Government Accountability Office found.

item.title: Pulse Poll: Measuring the impact of recent military operations in Iran on DoD
item.description: Federal News Network wants to learn more about the impact the military operations in Iran are having on the Defense Department workforce.

item.title: How NAVWAR is keeping the small business light burning
item.description: Kim Reidy, the director of the Office of Small Business Programs for NAVWAR, said the command is doing more to attract non-traditional small firms.
